name: Freedom—Shape-shifting weapon from codol
teaser: It's a shape-shifting weapon from CODOL. Can be switched between sniper mode and shotgun mode
description_html:
Since I can’t draw this weapon, let’s experience it in the Tarkov！

You can buy the weapon from Prapor

Anamorphic animation was made by me in accordance with the CODOL representation frame by frame

Press T to transform and switch between sniper mode and shotgun mode

All bullets are allowed

This is a completely new endeavor, so there may be some unknown bugs that I can’t fix：For example, fire sounds sometimes don’t match correctly
